event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: Panel composed as per RRS N1.4(b).
The International Jury decided to protest Thetis under RRS 60.4(c)(2) based on the information from case 49 since she was involved in the incident and might have broken a rule.
Cases 49 and 53 were heard together under 63.2(b) as they concern the same incident.
facts: The boats were around 13 meters long.
Morpheus was on starboard tack close-hauled, Thetis and Tanit were on port tack close-hauled collision course with Morpheus, with Thetis aiming bow to bow with Morpheus.
Thetis and Tanit were overlapped, with Thetis around a boat length to leeward, bow to bow.
Around 3 boat lengths away from Morpheus, the tactician of Thetis hailed for room to tack multiple times using words "you have to tack, please tack, tack tack".
There was initially no response from Tanit.
When Thetis and Morpheus were around 1 boat length away, all 3 boats luffed; Thetis and Tanit tacked.
The smallest distance between Morpheus and Thetis was around 4 meters.
conclusions: Thetis and Tanit had to keep clear of Morpheus, hence she was an obstruction to them.
Thetis, as the right-of-way boat versus Tanit, had the right to choose on which side to pass the obstruction as per RRS 19.2(a).

Thetis was approaching an obstruction and needed to make a substantial course change to avoid it safely and was sailing close-hauled course, hence she was entitled to hail for room to tack as per RRS 20.1.
Thetis did not hail for room to tack using the words required by RRS 20.2(c).
Thetis, on port, failed to keep clear of Morpheus on starboard breaking RRS 10.
Tanit kept clear and gave room to Thetis complying with her obligations under RRS 11 and 19.2(b).
